HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming acid damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various acid types.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming cold damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various cold types.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming electric damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various electric types. Note that lightning strikes actually do flame damage, and as such are affected by incoming heat damage factor instead.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming explosive damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various kinetic explosions.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming heat damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various heat-related types. Note that lightning strikes actually do flame damage, and as such are affected by this stat.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming psychic damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various psychic types.\n\nPsychic damage types are very rare; although some anomalous entities use psychic damage, they typically apply it as part of an instant-kill effect which does not need the damage to function, so this stat is only useful if you have mods that add more conventionally-applied sources of psychic damage.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming radiation damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various radiation-related types.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming skip damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various teleportation-related types.\n\nSkip damage types are very rare, often associated with archotech or psycast phenomena.

HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.label: incoming toxin damage factor
HautsFramework.SpecificDamageFactorStatD.description: A multiplier on incoming damage taken of various toxin types.\n\nThis does not directly affect one's resistance to toxic buildup, although some of the affected damage types inflict toxic buildup in proportion to the amount of damage inflicted.
